image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of an open white ring binder lying flat. The left side shows the metal ring mechanism with two visible rings holding a stack of papers. The top page contains hand-drawn sketches, diagrams, and handwritten text in black marker/pen. The handwriting appears stylized and somewhat illegible, resembling pseudo-text or rough notes. The background is a blurry, neutral surface.
